clue.text: In pain, MD he originally used as source of drugs

indicators.note: letters used in an original, novel way are rearranged into a fresh order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A doctor in pain resorted to cannabis as a painkiller.
explanation.walkthrough: 'originally used' tells you to rearrange IN PAIN plus MD plus HE.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian hemp is the cannabis plant, from which marijuana and hashish are produced.

clue.text: Wild play, ignoring the odds? In vain

indicators.note: dropping the odd-numbered letters keeps the second, fourth, sixth and eighth

explanation.surface: Reckless gambling against the odds achieves nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the odds' looks like betting odds; it means odd-placed letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Idly can mean to no purpose, fruitlessly, as with idle threats.

clue.text: Organised information turned up at short notice

indicators.note: in a down clue turned up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
ad is short for advertisement, a notice

explanation.surface: Records arrived with little warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses AT plus AD; 'short notice' looks like little warning but is the shortened advertisement.
explanation.definitionFit: Data are facts and figures collected for reference or analysis.

clue.text: A number of patients

parts.note: read number as a thing that numbs: one who makes patients numb before surgery

explanation.definitionFit: This hospital specialist administers drugs that remove sensation, numbing people.

clue.text: Starts off the line for a poet

indicators.note: the opening letter of each word is taken off

explanation.surface: Begin the verse for a writer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Starts off' removes the first letters of THE and LINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Heinrich Heine was a celebrated German Romantic poet.

clue.text: Natural intelligence of remaining wife in college

indicators.note: the other pieces are placed inside the college

parts.note: MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology
the other ones are those remaining

explanation.surface: A spouse left at university shows native brains.
explanation.definitionFit: Mother wit is innate common sense, as opposed to learning.

clue.text: For the most part, a friend that's genial

definitions.note: genial in anatomy means relating to the chin, so the thing that is genial is a noun

indicators.note: most of the word is kept, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: china is rhyming slang for mate (china plate), so a friend

explanation.surface: A good friend is mostly a cheerful soul.
explanation.walkthrough: CHINA (friend) loses its last letter to 'For the most part'. 'Genial' looks like cheerful, but in anatomy it means of the chin. 'China plate' is Cockney rhyming slang for mate.
explanation.definitionFit: The anatomical adjective genial describes the lower jaw's front, so the feature it describes fits.

clue.text: Riding in pursuit of fellow for place in Cambridgeshire

parts.note: hunting is riding to hounds in pursuit of a fox
a don is a fellow of a university college

explanation.surface: A college fellow goes hunting in the Fens.
explanation.walkthrough: A don is a university teacher, as at Cambridge.
explanation.definitionFit: Huntingdon is a market town in Cambridgeshire, England.

clue.text: Occasionally making a historical contrast

definitions.meaning: from time to time, at intervals
comparing the present with the past

explanation.surface: Sometimes one compares the present with history.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means sometimes, and literally sets the present against the past.

clue.text: Artist in European country given thanks for opera

indicators.note: the artist is placed inside the name of the country

parts.note: Latvia is a Baltic state in Europe
RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist
ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: A painter in the Baltics is thanked for staging an opera.
explanation.definitionFit: Verdi's La Traviata is one of the most often performed operas.

clue.text: Was familiar with Kipling's first novel

indicators.note: first takes only the opening letter of the author's name

parts.note: novel as an adjective means new

explanation.surface: Someone recognised the opening book Kipling wrote.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like a book, but it is the adjective meaning fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: To have known something is the past tense of being acquainted with it.

clue.text: Gated community in California?

parts.note: a community by a famous Gate: the city by the Golden Gate

explanation.definitionFit: The city on the Golden Gate strait is a Californian community beside a gate.

clue.text: Pronouncement made by fool with first lady helping

parts.note: an ass is a foolish person
Eve was the first woman in Genesis
a helping of food is a ration or portion

explanation.surface: An idiot makes a statement with the President's wife assisting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first lady' suggests a President's wife; here it is Eve, the first woman.
explanation.definitionFit: An asseveration is a solemn declaration or emphatic statement.

clue.text: Tommy planting tree on island

indicators.note: in a down clue on puts the tree above the island

parts.note: the service tree is a European tree related to the rowan
the Isle of Man lies in the Irish Sea

explanation.surface: A soldier plants a tree on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: A Tommy is a British private soldier.
explanation.definitionFit: Tommy Atkins is slang for a British soldier, a member of the armed services.

clue.text: Just as carefully considered

definitions.meaning: fair and right, as a decision may be
thought out with care before acting

explanation.surface: Equally thought through.
explanation.definitionFit: A well-judged decision is both fair and thought out, matching both senses.

clue.text: Part of cosmetic treatment I reportedly follow

indicators.note: reportedly signals that the letter is heard, not read

parts.note: the pronoun I sounds like the organ of sight
to shadow someone is to follow them secretly

explanation.surface: Someone says they follow a beauty routine.
explanation.definitionFit: Eyeshadow is a coloured powder applied to the eyelids as make-up.

clue.text: Madly loved me in American romance, say

indicators.note: madly means the letters are thrown into a wild new order

explanation.surface: A passionate lover in America is the stuff of romance.
explanation.definitionFit: A dime novel was a cheap popular American story, a romance being one example.

clue.text: Fruit he transferred, initially, to box

parts.note: a fig is a fruit

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the two words before it

explanation.surface: A fig was moved into a box.
explanation.walkthrough: 'box' looks like a container, but it is the verb to spar.
explanation.definitionFit: To box is to fight with fists in the ring, a direct synonym.

clue.text: After so long, little time for servant

indicators.note: after puts the short time at the end, following the farewell

parts.note: vale is Latin for farewell, as is so long
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: After a long wait, there is little time left for the help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'so long' reads as a duration but is the farewell VALE.
explanation.definitionFit: A valet is a manservant who attends to a gentleman's clothes.

clue.text: Satisfied individual had injected analgesic

indicators.note: the word had is put inside the other pieces like a drug in a vein

parts.note: a need that is met is satisfied
one means a single individual
taken as written

explanation.surface: A contented person had a painkiller injected.
explanation.definitionFit: Methadone is a synthetic opioid used as a painkiller and in treating heroin addiction.

clue.text: Double-decker taking priest to Channel port

parts.note: a priest is a small club used by anglers to kill fish
Sandwich is a Cinque Port in Kent near the English Channel

explanation.surface: A bus picks up a clergyman to take to a coastal port.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Double-decker' suggests a bus; it is a three-slice sandwich. A 'priest' is an angler's club, not a cleric.
explanation.definitionFit: A club sandwich has two layers of filling between three slices of bread.

clue.text: Peter's girl-friend has to travel on fourth of July

parts.note: to wend is to go or travel

indicators.note: fourth of takes the fourth letter of the month

explanation.surface: A girlfriend must travel on Independence Day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fourth of July' looks like the US holiday; it picks Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Wendy Darling is Peter Pan's companion in J M Barrie's story.

clue.text: Top Olympian taking some prize, usually

indicators.note: taking some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The top Olympic athlete normally takes some of the prize.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Olympian' suggests an athlete; it means a god of Olympus.
explanation.definitionFit: The king of the Greek gods ruled from Mount Olympus.

clue.text: A single piece of information, or a couple

definitions.meaning: one entry or detail on a list

explanation.definitionFit: An item is a single detail, and also a pair of lovers.

clue.text: Priests of old school rejected one

indicators.note: rejected means the word is thrown back, read backwards

parts.note: a gam is a school of whales
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: The old priests of a school spurned one pupil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' reverses GAM, a school of whales, to give MAG.
explanation.definitionFit: The Magi were the Zoroastrian priestly caste of ancient Persia.

clue.text: Disappearing from East part of church, returned with bouquet

indicators.note: returned means the church part is read backwards

parts.note: the nave is the main body of a church
a wine's bouquet is its scent

explanation.surface: Something fades from the eastern end of a church, coming back with a fragrance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns NAVE into EVAN. 'bouquet' is a wine's aroma, not flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: Evanescent means quickly fading or vanishing from sight.

clue.text: When you parked vehicle, finally, not in gear

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letter of each of the four words

explanation.surface: After parking the car, take it out of gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not in gear' suggests neutral; it means wearing no clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone without any gear or clothes on is naked.

clue.text: Extraordinarily plump, say, so give lifeless performance

indicators.note: the letters are arranged in an extraordinary new order

explanation.surface: A remarkably plump actor delivers a dead performance.
explanation.definitionFit: To play possum is to feign death, as the opossum does when threatened.
